selection: 20 Gangnam-gu/Seocho-gu and 20 Jamsil-dong/Sincheon-dong clinics, institution type 31. Each group prioritizes 10 records reporting urology, then deterministic SHA256 order among supported departments. This is a technical coverage pilot, not a representative clinical prevalence sample.
coverage: HIRA describes the preceding year relative to the reference month. The response does not provide exact start/end dates; do not fabricate day boundaries or treat retrieval date as treatment period.
response_schema: Actual response names use mfrnIntrsIlnsCdNm1..5 and shwSbjtCdNm, differing from the documentation's mfrnIntrsIlnsNm1..5 and shwSbjtNm. Import accepts both disease-name variants.
display_rules: Only 27 positively verified records are included in the pilot snapshot; no-record responses do not become negative claims about services.
Retain original Korean names and source order. English labels are editorial translations, not new diagnosis groupings.
No ordinal ranking, treatment counts, outcomes, qualification or language claims are inferred.
Source reference month and retrieval date are separate. No disease-specific analytics payload is added.
No production database writes, credential publication, bulk condition landing pages or disease structured-data claims are included.
